summary.text: Student activity at IIIT Allahabad runs through the Gymkhana and about eight official clubs spanning literary, sports, drama, music, technical and audio-visual interests, alongside the separate technical society GeekHaven and the robotics club Robita. The year builds toward two flagship fests: Effervescence, a multi-day cultural gathering in October, and Aparoksha, the technical fest in April, with the sports meet Asmita rounding out the calendar. Sports infrastructure centres on a football ground with an athletics track, a swimming pool, and courts for basketball, tennis, squash and volleyball, plus indoor games at the Student Activity Centre.
